name: ef-querylens-vscode
description: Preview your EF Core SQL in real time, without leaving your IDE.

commands.title: EF QueryLens: Set up (generate offline factory)

efquerylens.codeLens.maxPerDocument.description: Maximum number of query CodeLens entries to show per document.

efquerylens.codeLens.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to reuse cached CodeLens results for unchanged document text.

efquerylens.codeLens.useModelFilter.description: When enabled, CodeLens validates query roots against DbSet names from model inspection. Disable for maximum stability while debugging LSP crashes.

efquerylens.sql.formatOnShow.description: Format SQL before showing or copying from QueryLens commands.

efquerylens.sql.dialect.description: Dialect used by SQL formatter. Auto infers from SQL text.

efquerylens.debug.enableVerboseLogs.description: Emit verbose QueryLens client/server diagnostic logs to help isolate LSP or CodeLens issues.

efquerylens.showStatusBar.description: Show the global QueryLens readiness indicator in the status bar.

efquerylens.hoverWaitWhenWarmMs.description: Milliseconds to wait on the first hover when the assembly is already warm. 0 returns a processing hover immediately and shows a SQL-ready toast when background translation finishes.

efquerylens.hoverProgressNotify.description: Show progress notifications for slow hovers.

efquerylens.notifyWhenSqlReady.description: Show a toast with an Open SQL action when a background hover translation finishes.

efquerylens.dotnetPath.description: Optional full path to the dotnet executable. Use this when GUI-launched VS Code cannot find dotnet on PATH.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run prepare-runtime
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run prepare-runtime
